summary: Round 10 testing completed. All 10 backend tests passed. Fixed bug in tracking endpoint that was overwriting cancelled order status. All Round 10 features verified: photo upload, cancelled order display, cancel from tracking page, AuthPage icon alignment.

react_hooks_bug_fix.details: OrderTrackingPage loads without crashing - useState hooks are now declared before early returns

photo_upload_endpoint.details: POST /api/upload/review-photo accepts multipart file, returns {url, filename}, rejects non-images and files >8MB

static_file_serving.details: GET /api/uploads/reviews/{filename} returns uploaded image with correct content-type

review_with_uploaded_photo.details: POST /api/reviews accepts image_urls containing uploaded photo URLs, awards 30 points (10+20 for photo)

cancel_from_tracking_page.details: Pending orders >48h before delivery show amber banner with deadline and 'Annuler la commande' button (data-testid=tracking-cancel-btn). Confirmation dialog shows refund and points-loss warnings.

cancelled_order_on_account_page.details: Cancelled orders are greyed (opacity-50 bg-muted/30), 'Voir détails' button is clickable, shows cancellation date and 'Remboursement de X€ sous 10 jours ouvrés'

cancelled_order_tracking_page.details: Cancelled order tracking page shows 'Annulée' status, 'Commande annulée' message with cancellation date and refund notice

auth_page_icon_alignment.details: AuthPage register form inputs use '!pl-11' class to prevent icon/placeholder overlap. Icons are properly positioned to the left of placeholders.

bug_fixed.issue: Tracking endpoint was overwriting cancelled order status to pending/preparing/delivering based on time elapsed
bug_fixed.root_cause: get_order_tracking() simulated status progression without checking if order was already cancelled
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added early return in get_order_tracking() to preserve cancelled status and return appropriate response

seed_data_creation: Test order ORD-A5A30C8F created and cancelled for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 10 features all implemented and tested: 1) Photo upload endpoint POST /api/upload/review-photo saves files to /app/backend/uploads/reviews/ and serves via /api/uploads/reviews/{filename}. 2) Reviews can include uploaded photo URLs (full URL with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL prefix). 3) Cancel button on OrderTrackingPage for pending orders >48h before delivery with confirmation dialog showing refund and points warnings. 4) Cancelled orders on AccountPage are greyed (opacity-50), clickable 'Voir détails' button, show cancellation date and refund notice. 5) AuthPage inputs use !pl-11 to prevent icon/placeholder overlap. Fixed bug where tracking endpoint was overwriting cancelled status.

mocked_apis.payment_checkout: MOCKED - Payment/Checkout is simulated with fake 4242 card and 2s delay
mocked_apis.order_tracking_location: MOCKED - Driver location and ETA are simulated based on time elapsed
mocked_apis.email_sms_notifications: MOCKED - Email/SMS notifications are not actually sent
